name: Wizard
description: A master of arcane magic who harnesses the power of the cosmos and the elements to bend reality to their will.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wizards can cast spells from their spellbook, spending spell slots to harness their magical abilities.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day during a short rest, a wizard can recover expended spell slots with a combined level that does not exceed half their wizard level (rounded up).

bloodlineBonus: Increased spell damage by 2 for spells of chosen bloodline type.

name: Fighter
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a fighting style that enhances your combat capabilities.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: A surge of energy allows you to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level once per short rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn, usable once per short rest.

bloodlineBonus: Increase your attack or damage rolls with weapons of your choice.

name: Rogue
description: Rogues are cunning and skilled at stealth, deception, and infiltration.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Deal extra damage when the tactical conditions for a precision strike are met.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: Choose an archetype that provides additional features and abilities.

bloodlineBonus: Gain proficiency in dexterity saving throws and a bonus to stealth checks.

name: Cleric
description: Divine spellcasters who channel the power of a deity to heal, protect, and smite.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: Channel divine power through prepared spells.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Channel divine energy to produce a powerful sacred effect.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a domain that shapes your divine abilities.

bloodlineBonus: Gain an additional skill proficiency related to your divine calling.

name: Ranger
description: Skilled hunters and trackers who combine martial prowess with wilderness expertise and nature magic.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose a creature type and gain specialized tracking and hunting benefits.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: Gain advantages when navigating and surviving in a favored environment.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a fighting style that enhances your combat capabilities.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Gain access to ranger nature magic.

bloodlineBonus: Gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity and proficiency in survival checks.

name: Barbarian
description: A primal warrior who turns fury, endurance, and raw physical power into devastating combat strength.

features.name: Rage
features.description: Enter a battle fury that increases durability and melee damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Use agility and toughness to defend without heavy armor.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: Strike with overwhelming force while accepting greater risk.

features.name: Primal Path
features.description: Choose a specialized expression of primal power.

bloodlineBonus: While raging, bloodline manifestations gain increased physical impact.

name: Paladin
description: A divine champion who combines martial discipline, protective power, and an oath that shapes supernatural abilities.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: Detect powerful supernatural presences and threats.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: Restore an ally's vitality through divine healing power.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: Channel divine power through a successful weapon strike.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.description: Bind yourself to an oath that defines your divine path.

bloodlineBonus: Divine manifestations can inherit the symbolism and damage affinity of the chosen bloodline.

name: Druid
description: A primal spellcaster who draws on nature, transformation, and the living forces of the world.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: Know the secret language and traditions of druids.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Channel primal magic through prepared nature-based spells.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: Transform into an appropriate beast form.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: Choose a circle that defines your relationship with primal power.

bloodlineBonus: Primal spells and transformations can reflect the chosen bloodline's nature.

name: Bard
description: A versatile performer whose magic, knowledge, and influence turn artistry into practical power.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: Inspire allies with a die of performance-fueled potential.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast spells through music, speech, or another creative medium.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Apply broad experience to tasks outside your strongest specialties.

features.name: Bard College
features.description: Choose a tradition of performance and magical study.

bloodlineBonus: Performance magic can manifest as an audible or visual expression of the chosen bloodline.

name: Monk
description: A disciplined martial artist who turns body, movement, and focused inner energy into supernatural technique.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Use disciplined unarmed strikes and monk weapons with exceptional speed and precision.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Spend focused inner energy to power special techniques.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Move with exceptional speed while unarmored.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.description: Choose a tradition that defines your disciplined techniques.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Disrupt an enemy with a precisely timed empowered strike.

bloodlineBonus: Focused techniques can channel the chosen bloodline as an elemental, shadow, or spiritual manifestation.
